purpose: Public forty-prompt live regression; not held-out musical quality or a controlled performance comparison.

environment.metadata: installed local Discogs SQLite; MusicBrainz, Discogs and AcousticBrainz provider fallback; live verified previews

limitations: First mode parsed fresh; other modes reused exactly those raw intents, not post-discovery metadata.
Enhanced replay retained the local server for replacement-anchor proposals. Engine-only replay used no auxiliary providers or audio model.
Existing evaluation caches were reused, not cleared. CLAP-first followed AcousticBrainz-first and had warmer caches; candidate/evidence pools were not frozen.
Deej-AI-only overlapped early CLAP-first; repository validation overlapped early AcousticBrainz-first.
Per-case elapsed times exclude model/catalog initialization; the first mode includes fresh initial parsing, replays do not.
No private listening history or held-out relevance judgments were used.
AcousticBrainz archive status counts are repeated knowledge-snapshot record occurrences, not unique catalog coverage.
New-analysis counters include attempts and unavailable previews, not just successful audio analyses.
